dependencies.title: VC-7/W18-B: pure native executable identity observation (realpath + sha256 for absolute paths, PATH-resolved binaries labelled mutable-path, SDK default executable labelled unsupported, never executes) plus reattach comparison that never upgrades unknown to same; detached host wiring excluded
dependencies.description:
Gap: docs/workbench/15 names "native immutable deployment refs" as VC-7 acceptance and docs/workbench/08 says native executable identity is an unestablished release obligation; W18 (wb-5w0) notes "Native binaries ... not claimed" and W22 (wb-cax) notes "Full release/install native binary identity ... remain open". At rig ad3cf6e the detached host hard-codes `nativeRuntimeIdentity: "unsupported"` (src/workbench/hosts/local-detached.ts:82 and :96) and its runtimeClosure comment reads "Native executables launched by SDK defaults/PATH still have unsupported identity."; src/workbench/providers/forge.ts:80 launches ServerConnection.spawn("forge"), a bare PATH-resolved name; the Claude Agent SDK's Options.pathToClaudeCodeExecutable (node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts:1984) "Uses the built-in executable if not specified." Nothing in src/ can observe, pin or compare the bytes of a native executable, so no host can honestly report which binary it launched or refuse reattachment when that binary changed.

Scope (atomic, pure, hot-file free): ONE new source file src/workbench/executable-identity.ts and ONE new test file test/workbench-executable-identity.test.ts; wire nothing.
- export const EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT = 'workbench.executable-identity/v1'
- export type ExecutableIdentityReason = 'sdk-default-executable' | 'not-found' | 'not-a-file' | 'not-executable' | 'symlink-depth' | 'too-large' | 'unreadable' | 'path-resolved' | 'shadowed-candidates' | 'search-truncated' (frozen set; nothing else is ever emitted).
- export interface ExecutableObservation { contractVersion: typeof EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_CONTRACT; requested: string | undefined; resolution: 'absolute' | 'path-search' | 'unresolved'; resolvedPath?: string; realPath?: string; symlinkHops: number; digest?: string (sha256:<hex>); sizeBytes?: number; mode?: number; candidates: number; immutability: 'digest-observed' | 'mutable-path' | 'unsupported'; reasons: readonly ExecutableIdentityReason[]; observedAt: string }
- export function observeExecutableIdentity(input: { command: string | undefined; cwd: string; path: string | undefined; observedAt: string; maxBytes?: number; maxSearchEntries?: number; maxSymlinkHops?: number }): ExecutableObservation — synchronous; reads only through node:fs (lstat, readlink, stat, chunked reads for hashing — never readFileSync of a whole binary); never imports node:child_process; never reads process.env (PATH is an explicit input); never throws for a missing, unreadable, non-regular, non-executable or oversized target — those are 'unresolved'/'unsupported' with a reason.
  • command undefined or empty -> resolution 'unresolved', immutability 'unsupported', reasons ['sdk-default-executable'] (the honest answer for the Claude built-in executable and any SDK default).
  • command containing a path separator -> resolved against cwd; symlinks followed hop by hop (count hops; above maxSymlinkHops, default 16, -> 'unsupported' with 'symlink-depth'); must be a regular file with an execute bit; hashed with sha256 when sizeBytes <= maxBytes (default 512 MiB) -> resolution 'absolute', immutability 'digest-observed'; oversize -> digest omitted, immutability 'unsupported', reasons ['too-large'].
  • bare command -> PATH searched in order (split on path.delimiter; at most maxSearchEntries, default 64, further entries ignored and 'search-truncated' recorded; relative or empty entries resolved against cwd); the first regular executable file wins; candidates counts every searched entry holding a same-named executable; resolution 'path-search'; the digest IS observed but immutability is 'mutable-path' with reasons ['path-resolved'] plus 'shadowed-candidates' when candidates > 1. A digest never upgrades a PATH-resolved binary to 'digest-observed'.
  • Result and its reasons are frozen; resolvedPath and realPath pass through redactWorkbenchText (paths may embed tokens); absent fields mean not observed, never a default.
- export function compareExecutableIdentity(recorded: ExecutableObservation, current: ExecutableObservation): { verdict: 'same' | 'changed' | 'unknown'; differences: readonly string[] } — 'same' only when both digests are present and equal AND both immutability values are 'digest-observed'; 'changed' when both digests are present and differ; otherwise 'unknown' (a mutable-path or unsupported side can never yield 'same'); differences names each differing field (digest, realPath, sizeBytes, mode, immutability, resolution).

Out of scope: editing src/workbench/hosts/local-detached.ts (in flight under wb-6hb.1; the 'unsupported' literal is W18's later wiring point), src/workbench/providers/forge.ts, src/workbench/claude-host.ts, src/workbench/identity.ts; discovering the Claude built-in executable path from SDK internals; remote host authentication; Furnace ExecutorApp. If acceptance cannot be met without touching a hot or reserved file, stop and return blocked.

Files: src/workbench/executable-identity.ts (new); test/workbench-executable-identity.test.ts (new; mkdtemp fixtures with explicit modes only; nothing is executed). Imports: node:fs, node:path, node:crypto; redactWorkbenchText from src/workbench/redaction.ts (hot, import only). Specs: docs/workbench/08 (Separate four identities; Experimental immutable receipt; Optional local detached profile; Run recovery and journal design), docs/workbench/17 (Versioning / distribution), docs/workbench/12 (Supply chain; Credential boundaries), docs/workbench/15 (Vertical cuts VC-7), docs/workbench/02 WB-014/WB-041.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
All criteria quote docs/workbench specs in the rig (branch workbench/implementation-program, HEAD ad3cf6e). Red-first: test/workbench-executable-identity.test.ts fails before src/workbench/executable-identity.ts exists. All fixtures live under a mkdtemp directory with explicit modes; nothing is executed.

B1. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md section "Separate four identities": "2. Deployment: immutable digest of artifact, dependencies, configuration and compatible host ABI." -> for a fixture file written with mode 0o755 and referenced by absolute path, observeExecutableIdentity returns resolution 'absolute', immutability 'digest-observed', digest equal to 'sha256:' plus the hex sha256 of the same bytes, sizeBytes equal to the byte length, symlinkHops 0, candidates 1 and reasons []; observing process.execPath by absolute path also yields 'digest-observed', and two observations of it are deep-equal apart from observedAt.

B2. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md section "Experimental immutable receipt": "A model alias, mutable PATH or SDK default executable must not be advertised as an immutable native deployment merely because the JavaScript client is pinned." -> the bare name 'forge' (the literal src/workbench/providers/forge.ts:80 spawns) with a PATH of two temp directories each holding an executable 'forge' resolves to the FIRST directory with resolution 'path-search', candidates 2, immutability 'mutable-path' and reasons containing 'path-resolved' and 'shadowed-candidates' although digest is present; reversing the PATH order changes realPath and digest; command undefined yields resolution 'unresolved', immutability 'unsupported', reasons ['sdk-default-executable'] and no digest.

B3. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md section "Experimental immutable receipt": "The identity audit also pins explicitly resolved loaded SDK JavaScript files, rather than assuming a lockfile/archive proves the installed bytes." -> a symlink chain link2 -> link1 -> binary yields realPath equal to the binary's realpath, symlinkHops 2 and the same digest as the direct observation; a chain longer than maxSymlinkHops yields immutability 'unsupported' with reasons ['symlink-depth'] and no digest; a mode 0o644 file as the only PATH candidate yields resolution 'unresolved' with reasons ['not-executable']; a directory named like the command yields 'not-a-file'; a missing command yields 'not-found'; none of these throws.

B4. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md section "Run recovery and journal design": "Do not silently migrate a running invocation to new source/registry version." and docs/workbench/17-packaging-and-operations.md section "Versioning / distribution": "Pin immutable deploy artifact for reproducible observations." -> compareExecutableIdentity returns verdict 'same' for two digest-observed observations of identical bytes even when observedAt differs; 'changed' with differences including 'digest' after one byte of the fixture is rewritten; and 'unknown' whenever either side lacks a digest or is 'mutable-path' or 'unsupported' — a mutable-path pair with equal digests is 'unknown', never 'same'.

B5. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md section "Optional local detached profile": "Furnace-hosted durability and native executable identity are separate, unestablished release obligations." and docs/workbench/15-implementation-program.md section "Vertical cuts" VC-7: "Remote host authentication, reattachment, native immutable deployment refs, crash/uncertain-operation conformance." -> the module's own source, read by the test, contains none of 'node:child_process', 'process.env' or 'Date.now'; a 64-byte fixture observed with maxBytes 16 yields 'unsupported' with reasons ['too-large'] and no digest; the observation, its reasons array and the comparison result are frozen and JSON round-trip stable.

B6. docs/workbench/12-security.md section "Supply chain": "Pin SDK versions, package/artifact digests and provenance." and section "Credential boundaries": "redact tokens from logs, UI, recordings and failure messages." -> a PATH entry whose directory name contains 'Bearer abc123' never appears raw in resolvedPath, realPath or reasons (the redactWorkbenchText marker replaces it); a PATH with 100 entries and the match only in entry 90 is searched for at most maxSearchEntries (64) and reports resolution 'unresolved' with reasons containing 'search-truncated' rather than a certain 'not-found'.

B7. docs/workbench/02-atomic-requirements.md WB-014: "Workflow invocation carries definition, immutable implementation basis and logical invocation ID; native refs remain intact." and WB-041: "Optional detached workbench host permits Pi client disconnect/reconnect, without falsely claiming crash durability." -> contractVersion is exactly 'workbench.executable-identity/v1' on every observation; the whole suite runs with no TTY, no spawned process and no network; test/workbench-local-detached.test.ts stays green and git diff --name-only shows only the two new files.

Process: red-first; ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write on both files; no any; no inline imports; never weaken or delete existing tests; forge run lint / typing / test green in the worktree; hot and reserved files untouched; do not edit docs/TRACEABILITY.md.

[flywheel relay of Sr. Engineer rulings, 2026-10-15 ~13:40Z] F4 RULING (binds the comparison semantics): a mutable path whose digests differ is "changed" (fail-closed is correct); "unknown" is reserved for a missing or unreadable digest on either side; "same" requires equal digests. The delivered behaviour matches this ruling. F3 (carry into W18 wiring, owner-policy, no bead yet): an identity capture must resolve the ELF behind a wrapper (realpath of /proc/self/exe or the resolved interpreter), never pin process.execPath verbatim — on this host process.execPath is a mise bash wrapper.
